variants.headline: Looking back: builder signs for a new project
variants.sub: A construction contract for {project} has been awarded to {builder}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The builder {builder} had signed a contract for {project}.

A builder, a project and an agreed price. Those are solid terms for a story, but they are not a finished building. Readers can welcome a signed undertaking without letting the ceremony move the project all the way to completion. The difficult part is still what a contract is for.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We take a critical view of {target}. A signature should not shelter inadequate stewardship, and responsible construction requires a more demanding standard than satisfaction that someone has agreed to undertake the work.
